criticism: The revised producer addresses prior safety defects, but concurrent resume lacks exclusive ownership, the stated batch-byte bound can be exceeded, and failed user-bus preflight prevents the specified launch.
findings: --resume accepts active ingest/wait_source state without flock or live-owner checks and can overwrite owner receipts while first worker is alive
read_batch appends compressed row before checking8MiB limit; oversize singleton/prior batch exceed declared limit
Frozen user-bus preflight failed; parent must verify actual bus/cgroup before any launch
